These are xv6 locking exercises about kalloc and kfree. They say nothing about RISC-V LR/SC or ARM exclusives.

grades.quote: TSO atomic read-modify-writes and x86 instructions using the LOCK prefix are fully ordered and can be implemented either via an AMO with both _aq_ and _rl_ set, or via an LR with _aq_ set, the arithmetic operation in question, an SC with both _aq_ and _rl_ set, and a conditional branch checking the success condition.

grades.quote: The two forms of atomic instruction provided are load-reserved/store-conditional instructions and atomic fetch-and-op memory instructions.
grades.reason: Introduces RISC-V's load-reserved/store-conditional instructions as one of the two atomic forms for synchronization. That is the RISC-V analogue of ARM exclusives. It gives no ARM comparison and no lock-loop details.
